sloka: कस्त्वं केन कथं चेह प्राप्तो वानरपुङ्गव ।का च रामेण ते प्रीतिस्तन्मे शंसितुमर्हसि ।। ५.५८.९४ ।।।।
transliteration: kastvaṁ kena kathaṁ ceha prāpto vānarapuṅgava ।kā ca rāmeṇa te prītistanme śaṁsitumarhasi ।। 5.58.94 ।।।।

translations.english: "Hearing her I also said, 'O queen Sugriva, the warrior of fierce valour and king of monkeys developed friendship with your husband'.
